newsitem.title: GREECE: BANK OF CYPRUS CUTS MORTGAGE RATE TO 13.9 PCT.
newsitem.headline: BANK OF CYPRUS CUTS MORTGAGE RATE TO 13.9 PCT.

text.p: The Bank of Cyprus cut its mortgage rate by 110 basis points down to 13.9 percent -- "the cheapest drachma floating rate mortgage" -- it said in a statement.
The loan, which has a grace period of 18 months, can run up to 15 years for amounts of five to 50 million drachmas.

Its floating rate home repair loans were also reduced by 100 basis points to 18 percent. These may finance up to five million drachmas with a pay back period of 48 months. Prepayments are not subject to additional charges, it said.
The Bank of Cyprus also offers mortgage and home repair loans in foreign currency at competitive rates. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
